repo_notes: Better-Lyrics is a Kotlin library for parsing and managing TTML (Timed Text Markup Language) lyrics, including word-by-word synchronization support.
Used as a Gradle module (':betterlyrics') in the N-Zik app (see N-Zik-Group/N-Zik settings.gradle.kts).
Fork of the Better Lyrics implementation originally created by MetroList.
Code lives in src/main/kotlin/com/metrolist/music/betterlyrics/: BetterLyrics.kt (fetch/parse entry point, public fetchTTML), TTMLParser.kt (TTML parsing) and models/ (Track.kt).
Tone: concise technical library documentation for Kotlin/Android contributors.

page_notes.content: Introduction: what the library parses, where it is used (N-Zik), and its relationship to the MetroList fork.
TTMLParser.kt: TTML document structure, timings, and how lyrics entries are extracted.
How per-word timing data is represented and consumed for synced lyrics display.
models/Track.kt and the lyric data structures produced by the parser.
TTMLParserTest.kt: parsing scenarios covered and how to add new fixtures.
Adding the library as a Gradle submodule in Android projects (':betterlyrics').
